about_the_game:
Once again, you're tasked with the duty of the interrogator. This time around, you're backed up with a partner, Charles. He's an interrogator too.

Together, you'll investigate and potentially solve a number of cases and defeat the crime once and for all.

Note that the game features a small embedding model localized within game's files, not an advanced AI system like LLM/Llama/GPT. It runs locally, on your computer, game doesn't require any internet connection. If you're expecting an immersive AI experience, you will be disappointed. The Primary tool of input is either word of mouth or written text. Conversation is the main focus of the game.

The game includes an unholy amount of AI-generated content, including, but not limited to:

  • Textures

  • Images

  • Music

  • Audio effects

  • Voice lines

  • Facial and body animations

  • Code

There's a humorous aspect to the game, intentional and otherwise.

content_descriptors.notes: At this moment depiction of violence is contained to case file description. You might read about deceased subject of violence in gory detail, for instance in pathologist's report.
